# 0125. pocock-files.js writes .out-of-scope/, docs/PROJECT.md, docs/capabilities/ and docs/agents/ with…

## Context and Problem Statement

Task #193: feat(files): .out-of-scope/, docs/PROJECT.md, docs/capabilities/, docs/agents/.

## Considered Options

The options are not listed apart; the decision below says what was chosen and why.

## Decision Outcome

pocock-files.js writes .out-of-scope/, docs/PROJECT.md, docs/capabilities/ and docs/agents/ with the shared writer; a done task's spec deltas merge into capabilities once, keyed "&lt;capability&gt;--&lt;requirement&gt;"

- Out of scope: one file per section (`# <concept>` and its reasoning, Pocock's triage OUT-OF-SCOPE format), title and text read back.
- PROJECT.md and each capability: the document's Markdown, sections read back with parseManaged. PROJECT.md is not a docs-sync kind, so the sync reports of repos without one do not change.
- Deltas: when the spec's task is done, added/modified write the requirement, renamed its title, removed supersedes it; a meta mark keeps it to once, so later edits of the capability stay.
- docs/agents/issue-tracker.md and domain.md: Pocock's setup files pointing his skills at Imprimatur's tools and .scratch/; written once a repo uses the new kinds.
- With it, inside() checks the deepest folder that exists (a symlinked folder above one still to be made), and .scratch/ refuses symlinked entries: from the automated security review of #192.

Not listed apart; see the decision outcome.
